 Print Television actor-turned-host and Maahi Vij's ex-husband Jay Bhanushali has expressed his anger against Bigg Boss 20 contestants for bringing up his daughter Tara 's name during the task. He took to his social media account and lashed out at the contestants. Jay also expressed his concern over how the controversial reality show is impacting his children. He revealed in a social media post that he has taken a decision as a father, that he will not allow his children to watch Bigg Boss 20 anymore. He further urged people not to tag him in Bigg Boss 20-related posts, stating that he wants to keep his family away from unnecessary negativity. Jay shared a long note on his Instagram account and voiced his anger over contestants involving daughter Tara and Mahhi Vij's role as a mother in their fights inside the Bigg Boss house. He stated that the BB 20 housemates have full rights to not agree with Mahhi's gameplay and can also question her moves, but dragging her kids into the discussions is not acceptable. Speaking about his decision, Jay wrote, "After witnessing everything on Bigg Boss, I have made one decision as a father - I will not let my children watch Bigg Boss anymore. I had decided that I will never speak about anyone's gameplay or give my opinion about any particular contestant and support Mahhi wherever I am needed. Further, in the post, Jay slammed YUNG DSA and Kanika Mann for making comments about Tara growing up and feeling ashamed of her mother's actions. He also highlighted about Kanika saying she never wanted to meet Mahhi's children and Love Gill 's mother mentioning his daughter was unfair. He questioned why children were being brought into the fights on a reality show. He wrote, "JUST FOR A TASK - Yung DSA talking about my children growing up and feeling ashamed of their mother's actions, Kanika saying she would never want to meet Mahhi's children, and Love Gill's mother bringing my daughter into the conversation by questioning how she would feel if someone said something similar about her daughter. Tara is 7 years old baby she is NOT a contestant of Bigg Boss getting a child to put someone down is absolutely nonsense. " Jay added, "Bigg Boss is a game. Disagree with Mahhi, question her gameplay and challenge her decisions, but bringing her children, motherhood and personal life into it is crossing a boundary." He ended the note by making clear that his children's emotional well-being and innocence will always matter more to him than the show. "He wrote, "As a father, I don't want my children growing up with a trauma that Tara's name is used in every sentence to put Mahhi down. The game may be entertainment for everyone, but for us, this is personal. My children's peace and innocence will always come first. Thank you. Good bye BIGG BOSS 20. " Jay captioned his post urging people to not tag him or his kids in any post," he concluded. For the uninitiated, Jay and Mahhi announced their separation in January 2026 after years together. In their joint statement, the former couple said they had chosen separate paths but would continue to have each other’s backs. They also emphasised their commitment to being present for their children, Tara, Khushi and Rajveer.
